player_prompt.intro: Ungumdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-Indian Poker. - I-deck yamakhadi angama-52; ubona ikhadi lomphikisi kuphela. - Ante {ante} ama-chip (s) umjikelezo ngamunye, {max_rounds} ama-round (s) esewonke. - Ukuhamba okuvumelekile: '[check]' │ '[bet X]' │ '[call]' │ '[raise X] │ '[fold]' (X yinombolo ephelele enhle <= inani lakho lama-chip.) - Ikhadi elifihliwe eliphakeme kakhulu liwina imbiza ngesikhathi sokubonisa.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Nikeza isenzo esisodwa esifakwe phakathi kwemishayo, isibonelo, "[check]", "[bet 2]", "[call]", "[raise 3]", noma "[fold]".
invalid_move.amount_min: Inani lokubheja / lokukhulisa kufanele libe ngu- ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Akukho okuzobizwa ngakho; ungenza [check] esikhundleni salokho.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Sebenzisa [bet X] ukuvula; akukho ukubheja okuzokwenyuka.

message.showdown_tie: Ukuqagela: bobabili {card}. Ibhodwe lihlukaniswe  ngamunye uthola {split}.

outcome.draw: Amasheke alinganayo ngemva kwazo zonke izinhlangothi
